sources.title: Chronos-2 — TSFM.ai
sources.snippet: Chronos-2 is Amazon's universal successor to the original Chronos family, at 120M parameters. The official card frames it as a single model that handles univariate, multivariate, and covariate-informed forecasting in one architecture, a more general design than the univariate-first checkpoints of the first Chronos generation.
